title: Churn Risk Over Time (Synthetic Lumen)
description: Repeated churn predictions per subscriber from the temporal CatBoost model. Probabilities describe risk of not renewing at the next eligible renewal; revenue at risk = probability x next renewal price. Not realized or saved revenue.

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model_id FROM churn_predictions WHERE as_of_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT model_id FROM churn_predictions WHERE as_of_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: user
list.label: Subscriber
list.query: SELECT user_id FROM churn_risk_current WHERE model_id = '$model' ORDER BY churn_probability DESC, user_id LIMIT 200
list.definition: SELECT user_id FROM churn_risk_current WHERE model_id = '$model' ORDER BY churn_probability DESC, user_id LIMIT 200

panels.title: Current churn probability (mean of latest per subscriber)

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(churn_probability) AS "Mean current churn probability", COUNT(*) AS "Subscribers" FROM churn_risk_current WHERE model_id = '$model'

panels.title: Expected next-renewal revenue at risk (not saved revenue)

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(expected_revenue_at_risk_usd) AS "Revenue at risk ($)" FROM churn_risk_current WHERE model_id = '$model'

panels.title: Current churn probability by subscriber (latest prediction)

targets.rawSql: SELECT user_id AS "Subscriber", effective_at AS "As of", churn_probability AS "Churn probability", churn_probability_change AS "Change since previous", renewal_due_at AS "Renewal due", expected_revenue_at_risk_usd AS "Revenue at risk ($)" FROM churn_risk_current WHERE model_id = '$model' ORDER BY expected_revenue_at_risk_usd DESC NULLS LAST, churn_probability DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT effective_at AS "time", user_id AS metric, churn_probability AS value FROM churn_risk_trajectory WHERE model_id = '$model' AND user_id IN ($user) AND $__timeFilter(effective_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Change in churn risk since the previous prediction (selected subscribers)

targets.rawSql: SELECT effective_at AS "time", user_id AS metric, churn_probability_change AS value FROM churn_risk_trajectory WHERE model_id = '$model' AND user_id IN ($user) AND churn_probability_change IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(effective_at) ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', effective_at) AS "time", AVG(churn_probability) AS "Mean churn probability", SUM(expected_revenue_at_risk_usd) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT date_trunc('day', effective_at)), 0) AS "Revenue at risk ($)" FROM churn_risk_trajectory WHERE model_id = '$model' AND $__timeFilter(effective_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Largest risk increases in the selected time range

targets.rawSql: SELECT user_id AS "Subscriber", effective_at AS "As of", previous_churn_probability AS "Previous", churn_probability AS "Now", churn_probability_change AS "Change", expected_revenue_at_risk_usd AS "Revenue at risk ($)" FROM churn_risk_trajectory WHERE model_id = '$model' AND churn_probability_change > 0 AND $__timeFilter(effective_at) ORDER BY churn_probability_change DESC LIMIT 25
